Name: Bitcoin Cash
Creator: Satoshi Nakamoto
Description: Bitcoin Cash is a cryptocurrency and open-source project that originated from a fork of the Bitcoin network on 1 August 2017. According to its supporters, its aim is to continue the vision of the creator of the Bitcoin protocol (Satoshi Nakamoto) for a peer-to-peer electronic cash system, drawing on the white paper and the author’s public statements in forums and mailing lists. Its community emphasises the currency’s role as a medium of exchange, as well as the need for a scalable network capable of meeting growing demand independently of complementary second-layer solutions such as sidechains, payment channels like the Lightning Network, or other systems with off-chain accounting.
